dossier.headline: Hospital stocks swing on drug-price scrutiny and broker calls
dossier.summary: Hospital stocks fell 8–12% from 22 Sep on the Supreme Court's scrutiny of cancer-drug markups, then rallied on 9 Oct when the Centre moved to cap trade margins at 30% of MRP. Macquarie upgraded Apollo and Max Healthcare to Outperform on 20 Nov, lifting both to the top of the Nifty. On 25 Nov both were among the top Nifty losers even as the wider market rallied.
why_it_matters: Drug-pricing rules are the main policy risk for hospital earnings
Hospitals have traded as defensive picks during global sell-offs and lag when risk appetite returns
